description: This file defines a template class 'CommandInterface' within the 'WebSockets' namespace, providing an interface for sending commands over WebSocket connections, handling responses, and message reception. It includes synchronization primitives and logging, and is intended for use as a base class for WebSocket communication implementations.

classes.name: CommandInterface
classes.description: A template class providing command sending and message handling functionalities for WebSocket communication, designed to be inherited by specific WebSocket client implementations.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command string over WebSocket, waits for a response, and returns success status.

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, updates the last response, and notifies waiting threads.
